top_signals.title: Robinhood to Offer Weekend Equities Trade; Cal-Maine Falls on Sales Miss | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Cal-Maine (CALM) shares fell after the egg producer reported net sales for the first quarter that missed the average analyst estimate, and said it won’t pay a cash dividend in the first quarter. 
- Concentrix (CNXC) shares are sliding after the software company’s reported revenue forecast for the fourth quarter missed the average analyst estimate.
- Robinhood (HOOD) is on the move as it plans to offer weekend trading for equities in a first for modern US markets, allowing customers to trade a selected list of stocks and exchange-traded funds over the weekend. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Deutsche Bank CEO warns Germany’s political shift is troubling foreign investors
top_signals.summary: Deutsche Bank CEO Christian Sewing warned that recent election results could hurt Germany’s appeal to international investors.

top_signals.title: Honeywell Gets $300 Million Deal for Dangote Kenya Refinery
top_signals.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE picked Honeywell Technologies for a $300 million contract to provide engineering services and technology at its planned Kenya refinery slated to be finished in record time.

top_signals.title: Japan officially overhauls permanent residency rules
top_signals.summary: The country finalized sweeping rule changes for its most coveted immigration status on Thursday, including higher income and language requirements.
